messages:
Alex P: Quick sync — proposing a tiered release for the 'adaptive-routing' change. Draft plan below; looking for eng + ops + SRE signoff. TL;DR: internal 10% -> pilot customers 5% -> open beta 25% -> gradual ramp to 100%. Auto-rollback on p95 latency regressions, error spikes, or quality drops.

Mike R: Can you post exact thresholds? need concrete numbers to wire into monitors and the autoswitch.

Alex P: Sure. Proposed triggers: p95 latency increase > 20% (vs baseline) OR error_rate absolute > 0.5% OR quality-signal drop > 2% on our eval cohort. Behavior: rollback the most-recently-added slice on trigger; if trigger persists for 10m, page SRE. Auto-rollback immediately if trigger occurs in 3 consecutive 5m windows.

Daria ML: For quality: we'll run eval-rls-v2 (≈500 prompts). Quality = top-1 token match + hallucination score. 2% drop threshold is conservative but should catch regressions. I'll produce a baseline CSV by EOD.

Katie SRE: Ops asks: pick a flag key, slice TTL, region caps (EU capped to 10% to start), and a hard fallback target (we should fall back to 'routing_v1'). Also need dedicated logging + sampled traces for canaries.

Alex P: Proposed flag config (draft):
```yaml
flag: adaptive_routing_v1
slices:
  - name: internal-10
    pct: 10
    regions: global
  - name: pilot-5
    pct: 5
    include_customers: ["acme", "zebra"]
  - name: open-beta-25
    pct: 25
rollout_rules:
  - metric: p95_latency
    op: ">"
    delta_pct: 20
    action: rollback-slice
  - metric: error_rate
    op: ">"
    delta_abs: 0.5
    action: rollback-slice
  - metric: quality_delta
    op: ">"
    delta_pct: 2
    action: rollback-slice
fallback: routing_v1
auto_escalate: true
```

Mike R: Suggestion: add a soft_degrade action for transient latency blips where we cut the slice pct by 50% for a single 5m window instead of a full rollback. This reduces noise and helps diagnose transient capacity vs quality issues.

Alex P: Agreed — soft_degrade for single-window p95 spikes, hard rollback for persistent latency or any quality regression. I'll update the config accordingly.

Daria ML: I'll add a prompt-weighted evaluation to make sure critical intents (billing, auth) are heavily weighted in the metric. Posting baseline numbers soon.

Katie SRE: I'll draft the runbook and the feature-flag toggle playbook (including how to yank a slice, who to page, and postmortem checklist). Plan: schedule internal-10 for tomorrow, pilot slice the week after pending baselines. @oncall-planning FYI.

srebot: Deploy started for internal-10 slice at 2024-05-01T14:02Z :rocket:

Alex P: Thanks — I'll update the rollout doc with the final thresholds, soft_degrade logic, and region caps, then tag for formal signoff.
